purpose: The capture half of a semantic profile for a GlmMoeDsaForCausalLM checkpoint served eager at TP8 on Hopper (sm_90, the 8xH200 run): every module the pinned vLLM builds for the checkpoint's config.json, what each one computes on the forward path, and the taps the committer attaches to -- each tap's tensor, dtype, shape on one TP rank, where it is captured, and whether a Program checks it today (exists), tonight (tonight), after a kernel is pinned to an existing family (port), or not at all (committed-only: bound by the Commit, reported as an unverified unit, never folded into delta). The module list is checked against the meta-device inventory of the same config (verity_vllm.engine.meta_inventory; tests/check/test_capture_map.py), so a module the map misses fails a test. A tap marked target_only runs only on the target device (an H200): its kernels have no build for the nodes the inventory and the tests run on.

inventory_runs.VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM=0: r20261003-072626-b966 (inv-tp8-cutlass.json, ranks 0-7, the target profile; tests/check/fixtures/glm_moe_dsa)
inventory_runs.default: r20261003-072626-b966 (inv-tp8-default.json, rank 0: DeepGemmFp8BlockScaledMMKernel; check-default.txt: 11 problems, 2 switches and 9 kernel expectations); r20261003-062327-45fd (ranks 0-7)
inventory_runs.VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1: r20261003-062327-45fd (log-bi.txt: refused, no sparse MLA backend supports batch invariance)

env_reasons.VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM: 0 puts every dense FP8 linear on CutlassFp8BlockScaledMMKernel, the kernel fp8.ScaledMmFp8Block@1 models (exact-model-tested on H100 with VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM=0). The default (1) selects DeepGemmFp8BlockScaledMMKernel with ue8m0 activation scales and weights requantized to ue8m0 at load: a different function with no Program yet. The indexer's DeepGEMM logits kernels are gated on the package, not on this variable, and still run.
env_reasons.VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT: 1 is refused at engine build on sm_90: FLASH_ATTN_MLA_SPARSE, FLASHMLA_SPARSE and FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_SM90 all report 'batch invariance not supported'. The Commit runs without it and replay uses the same batch layout.

selections.attention_backend: FLASH_ATTN_MLA_SPARSE (FlashAttnMLASparseImpl, masked_mha_available false): decode and long prefill take the absorbed MQA path
selections.prefill_backend: FlashAttnPrefillBackend, vllm_flash_attn_version 3 (qk head 256, v head 256, 8 heads per rank, scale 1/16): the dense-mha route
selections.fp8_moe_backend: TRITON (oracle.fp8: on sm_90 with 128x128 block FP8 and no expert parallelism Triton is moved to the front)
selections.router: GroupedTopKRouter -> _C.grouped_topk (sigmoid, n_group 1, topk_group 1, renormalize, routed_scaling_factor 2.5 inside the kernel)
selections.rotary: one shared RotaryEmbedding (is_neox_style false, base 8e6, cos_sin_cache [1048576, 64] bf16); the indexer's rope is the same instance (indexer_rope_interleave true)
selections.allreduce_norm: fused_allreduce_rms_norm: FlashInfer TRT-LLM fused all-reduce + residual add + RMSNorm (fp32 accumulation) when the step's token count M <= 0.5 MiB / (H * 2 B) = 42 at TP8 on sm_90 and the NVSwitch workspace exists; otherwise tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce then RMSNorm.forward_cuda (fused_add_rms_norm). Decode steps take the first path, a 256-token prefill the second.
selections.embedding: VocabParallelEmbedding sharded (19360 rows per rank): masked gather then all-reduce; fused_embed_norm is not used (it needs the full table on a rank)
selections.mtp: num_nextn_predict_layers 1 is not built: no speculative decoding in the serve command

routes.dense-mha: a prefill step whose longest sequence has at most TOPK keys (sparse_mla_attention: prefill_max_seq_len <= topk_tokens; the layer's prefill backend is FlashAttnPrefillBackend on FA3): kv_b_proj up-projects the step's normed latents, FA3 runs dense causal attention over q = [q_nope | roped q_pe], k = [k_nope | k_pe], v, and the indexer skips its scoring (dense_mha_metadata_layer_name), leaving topk_indices_buffer unwritten. The B1 row's 256-token prefill takes it
routes.sparse-mqa: every decode step, and a prefill over more than TOPK keys: the indexer scores the cached keys and writes the top TOPK, forward_mqa attends over the MLA cache at those keys in the latent space, then the W_UV bmm. With fewer than TOPK keys cached every key is selected (the rest of the row is -1)

step_routes.prefill: dense-mha when the step's longest prefill sequence <= TOPK, else sparse-mqa
step_routes.mixed: a step with prefill and decode tokens takes both routes when its prefill takes dense-mha (forward_impl runs forward_mha for the prefill tokens and the MQA path for the decode tokens, and the indexer scores), else sparse-mqa
step_routes.recorded: per layer and step from route_site (acquire.sources.route_source); a tap with a route is captured only on a step that takes it

route_site.detail: called with the layer's attention metadata once per layer and step in _sparse_indexer_and_attn before it attends (again in forward_impl when the step has prefill tokens): True sends the prefill tokens to forward_mha, False sends every token to forward_mqa; a step's decode tokens (attn_metadata.num_decode_tokens > 0) take the MQA path on either answer

free_symbols.M: tokens this step on every rank (TP replicates the batch)
free_symbols.MS: rows sampled this step (logits_indices: one per running request)
free_symbols.CTX: the indexer logits' key width: the prefill chunk's total key count, or max_model_len on a decode step

embedding-shard.note: one rank of VocabParallelEmbedding: the row table[tok - START] when the rank owns the token, else zeros (START = rank * VS)

fp8-block-linear.note: _C.per_token_group_fp8_quant + CUTLASS sm_90 blockwise GEMM (128x128 weight blocks, f32 promotion per 128-wide K block), exact-model-tested on H100 (VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM=0). Weights are the checkpoint words. The target's fp8_scale_construction (shared-per-block, the default) binds ScaledMmFp8BlockSharedScale_v1, ScaledMmFp8Block_v1's function with the scale products committed; per-coordinate binds ScaledMmFp8Block_v1.

fp8-block-linear-deepgemm.note: DeepGemmFp8BlockScaledMMKernel: fp8_gemm_nt with ue8m0 (power-of-two) activation scales and weights requantized to ue8m0 at load (requant_weight_ue8m0_inplace). Only if the serve keeps VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM=1.

silu-mul.note: torch.ops._C.silu_and_mul (CUDA act_and_mul_kernel): SiluMul_v2, the Build's silu_mul. SiluMul_v1 is not this kernel's function (NaN, gate -inf, gates past expf overflow, -0)

silu-mul-block-quant.note: ops.silu_and_mul_per_block_quant(intermediate_cache1, group_size=128, e4m3) (csrc fused_silu_mul_block_quant.cu), which TritonExperts.apply launches in place of silu_and_mul + the w2 input's group quant for SiLU with 128x128 block FP8, no LoRA and no DeepGEMM e8m0: per element f32 silu(gate) * up kept in registers (never rounded to bf16), per 128-group max |y|, scale = max / 448 floored by the kernel's minimum, then e4m3 RN of y / scale. No Definition yet (fp8_moe.py on cursor/hopper-block-fp8-8c79 leaves it to its own); its two outputs are the w2 Program's xq and sx

bf16-add.note: ATen add on bf16: bf16_rn(f32(a) + f32(b)) per element, NaN 0x7FC0 (Bf16Add_v1; ResidualAdd_v1{N} per row, the Build's residual_add). Not Bf16AddF2fp_v1, the CUDA _f16Vec add inside fused_add_rms_norm (NaN 0x7FFF)

moe-sum.note: ops.moe_sum over the TOPK down rows (already weighted by the router in the down launch)

token-select.note: greedy argmax over the gathered logits (B1 row: temperature 0)

all-gather.note: the logits all-gather: the concatenation of the 8 vocab shards (AllGather_v1 at WORLD 8 is a reference rearrangement, no gates)

copy-equality.note: a value the runtime only moves (a cache write): checked by word equality against the taps it copies, no Program

sigmoid-router.note: _C.grouped_topk(logits, n_group=1, topk_group=1, topk=8, renormalize=True, routed_scaling_factor=2.5, bias, scoring_func=1): sigmoid scores, + e_score_correction_bias for selection only, top-8 of 256, renormalise, x2.5. MoeRouterSigmoidBias_v1{E, TOPK, SCALE, KERNEL} per token row: inputs logits (Array(E, F32), the gate's f32 row) and bias (Array(E, F32), e_score_correction_bias); output (topk_weights Array(TOPK, F32), topk_ids Array(TOPK, I32)) as the kernel writes them; KERNEL block (single_group_topk_block_kernel, M <= 1024 at E = 256) or warp

fp8-moe-triton.note: Triton fused_moe with 128x128 block FP8 (Fp8MoeBackend.TRITON): per_token_group_quant_fp8 of the expert input (ue8m0 iff DeepGEMM e8m0 is in use: off with VLLM_USE_DEEP_GEMM=0), w13 launch, then the w2 launch with MUL_ROUTED_WEIGHT

fused-rmsnorm-triton.note: deepseek_v32 common/kernels.py _rms_norm inside _fused_norm_rope_kernel: f32 tl.sum(x*x)/N, tl.rsqrt(+eps), * f32(w), to bf16. Its reduction tree and rsqrt must be pinned against the existing Triton RMSNorm family

rmsnorm-cuda.note: vLLM's default non-batch-invariant BF16 rms_norm / fused_add_rms_norm width-8 paths. The Program records BLOCK because M < 256 launches rms_norm at min(N/8,1024) and fused_add_rms_norm at min(N,1024), while M >= 256 launches both at 256; the H200 capture checks M 1,42,43,64,256,2048 at GLM-5.3 N=6144 and DeepSeek-V4-Pro N=7168

fused-rope-triton.note: interleaved (GPT-J) RoPE on the 64 rope dims inside _fused_norm_rope_kernel (k_pe) and fused_q (q_pe): f32 x1*cos - x2*sin, x2*cos + x1*sin from the bf16 cos_sin_cache, to bf16

tp-allreduce.note: the TP8 all-reduce on 8xH200 (custom / symm-mem / NCCL, chosen at runtime): AllReduce2_v1 is WORLD 2 and AllReduce_v2 WORLD 4 on L40S, neither this one. Every rank's partial is a tap, so a later AllReduce Program checks against the same root

fused-allreduce-rmsnorm.note: FlashInfer trtllm_allreduce_fusion (one-shot, fp32_acc, AR_RESIDUAL_RMS_NORM) on decode steps; on prefill steps the TP8 all-reduce then fused_add_rms_norm. No Program for either the fused kernel or the TP8 all-reduce

cublas-bf16-gemm.note: cuBLAS/cuBLASLt BF16 GEMM (F.linear, torch.mm out_dtype=f32, torch.bmm). The registered BF16 GEMMs model vLLM's batch-invariant Triton matmul_persistent, which runs only under VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 (refused for this model)

router-gemm.note: GateLinear bf16 x bf16 -> f32: cuteDSL ll_bf16_gemm for M <= 16 when available, else cuBLAS torch.mm(out_dtype=f32); which tier runs is a flag of the module (allow_ll_bf16_gemm / allow_cublas_router_gemm)

fa3-prefill-attention.note: FA3 dense causal prefill (FlashAttnPrefillBackend.run_prefill_new_tokens -> flash_attn_varlen_func, fa_version 3) at qk head 256 / v head 256. AttentionFA3_v1 is FA3 at head dim 128 (kBlockN 128, RescaleOBeforeGemm false); the head-256 tile geometry and rescale order must be pinned before it binds

mla-sparse-attention.note: FlashAttnMLASparseImpl.forward_mqa -> FA3 flash_attn_varlen_func (FLASH_ATTN_MLA_SPARSE: bf16 MLA cache, no DCP): per query token the NHL heads over the row's valid_counts selected rows [kv_c 512 | k_pe 64] in the top-k's order, scale 1/16: SparseMla_v1{T=valid count,NH=8,DR=64,DV=512,BN=64,DOT=HopperBF16WgmmaDot16_v1,INV=Fa3InvSum_v1,SCALE=0.0625}. FlashInfer's sparse path (FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_SM90) runs only with an fp8 KV cache or a named --attention-backend and has no Definition; port until the H200 capture (tests/properties/glm53_dsa_capture_gpu.py) pins the kernel variant and a Build rule binds it

dsa-indexer-q.note: fused_q (Triton _fused_q_kernel, num_warps 1; the CuTe DSL branch needs capability >= 100): per head the interleaved RoPE of the first 64 dims and the ue8m0 FP8 quantisation (q_fp8, port 1), and the head weight times the q scale, 128^-0.5 and 32^-0.5 (weights, port 2): DsaIndexerQ_v1{H=32,D=128,ROPE=64} per token; port until the H200 capture (tests/properties/glm53_dsa_capture_gpu.py) pins the kernel variant and a Build rule binds it

dsa-indexer-k.note: _fused_norm_rope_kernel, program 0: k_norm (LayerNorm, eps 1e-6, f32 weight and bias), the interleaved RoPE of the first 64 dims and the ue8m0 FP8 quantisation, written as the cache row (128 e4m3 bytes + one f32 scale): DsaIndexerKRow_v1{D=128,ROPE=64,EPS=1e-06} per row; port until the H200 capture (tests/properties/glm53_dsa_capture_gpu.py) pins the kernel variant and a Build rule binds it

dsa-mqa-logits.note: DeepGEMM fp8_mqa_logits (prefill) / fp8_paged_mqa_logits (decode), clean_logits False: per (query row, key) the sum over the 32 heads of relu(q_h . k) * w_h in the kernels' order, times the key's scale: DsaMqaLogits_v1{N=keys,H=32,D=128} per row. Only a row's keys are written (clean_logits False), so only those columns are compared; port until the H200 capture (tests/properties/glm53_dsa_capture_gpu.py) pins the kernel variant and a Build rule binds it

dsa-topk.when: every row has at most TOPK = 2048 keys
dsa-topk.note: top_k_per_row_prefill (prefill) / cooperative_topk (decode, at most 64 rows; else persistent_topk): a row of at most 2048 keys takes each kernel's shortcut, slot i = i when i < the row's length, else -1: DsaTopKShortRow_v1{TOPK=2048}. A longer row is a radix selection whose order (ties included) the kernels leave to their atomics, with no Definition; port until the H200 capture (tests/properties/glm53_dsa_capture_gpu.py) pins the kernel variant and a Build rule binds it

binders.module_hook: the committer's forward hooks on the modules of its acquired classes whose forward runs (commit/committer/native_host.py _make_hook, _make_pre_hook): <module> for a tensor output, <module>/<k> for tuple element k, <module>/in for an acquired input
binders.tp_partial: TPPartialSource (acquire/sources/partial_source.py): a collective's rank-local input, <site>/part_rank<r> or <site>/shard_rank<r>
binders.moe: MoeBlockSource (acquire/sources/moe_source.py): moe/L<i>/<plane>, snapshotted after each kernel of the fused-MoE block
binders.allreduce_norm: TPPartialSource's fused_allreduce_rms_norm wrap (acquire/sources/allreduce_norm.py): on every call the partial as <norm>/part_rank<r>, copied before the call; on the FlashInfer path, where the norm module never runs, the returns as <norm>/0 and <norm>/1. On the all-reduce + RMSNorm path the norm module runs and the module hook binds those two names, so a step commits the same names on either path
binders.attention: AttentionSource (acquire/sources/attention_source.py), on every attention layer: _sparse_indexer_and_attn's arguments before it runs (fused_norm_rope's q_c, kv_c_out and k_pe_out, the W_UK_T product, fused_q's outputs) and the layer's cache rows at the step's slot mapping, read from the caches fused_norm_rope was given; after it returns, the rows of output that forward_mqa's rows were up-projected into and topk_indices_buffer[:M, :TOPK]; impl.forward_mqa's return; impl.forward_mha's output argument after it returns (not bound with a chunked context). <attn>/<value> for the layer's values, <indexer>/<value> and <k_cache>/rows for the indexer's

capture_work.done: moe source: grouped_topk_router.grouped_topk bound as router_w / router_ids (the custom op is reached inside that function's torch.compile region, so the wrapper sits at the call-time global _compute_routing reads), with the kernel per step; the block-FP8 launches bound unchanged
